checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both closed hands stay on machine handles.
checks.feet: Both feet clear the floor. Straight legs raise together to hip height or remain horizontal for the L hold; fixed hands and trunk, no swing.
checks.movement: Overhand hanging straight-leg raise to hip height, 3.5 seconds up, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds down. Fixed trunk and arms without swinging; legs travel together.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
